games.description: A solo late-night encounter with the woman in red, followed through a bad ending, repeat runs, deaths, and a final hammer-assisted escape for the good ending.
games.title: Akai Onna

games.description: Four rounds of screenshot trivia with Twitch chat, from tiny early images to larger pictures and increasingly competitive guesses. Host advantage, ambiguous screenshots and repeated promises of one last round become part of the contest.
games.title: Chat Guess Games

games.description: A solo run through Anna’s mansion and catacombs, managing limited saves, ammunition, and inventory space. Acid mixing, gunpowder, keys, and mechanisms lead to the final confrontation with Lillian Shelby.
games.title: Despair: Blood Curse

games.description: A solo drive through increasingly demonic roads. Sark dodges roadside hazards, monsters, and swinging obstacles, retries the dangerous stretches, and reaches the last highway encounter and closing review.
games.title: Drive Me to Hell

games.description: Sark becomes a self-driving car for a distracted, increasingly drunk passenger. The solo bar crawl turns into a traffic-dodging test of patience, followed by an alternate run that draws the police.
games.title: Driving Home(icide)

games.description: Sark tries a meme military shooter, experiments with its extensive loadout options and fights through a chaotic match before checking its reviews.
games.title: Tim Climpy's Warfair

games.description: Sark tries to rescue a wolf’s children in a sprawling city, then gets distracted by debug controls, floating cars and a badly behaved camera.
games.title: Wolf in the City
